rationale: tv_iterative-claude-agentic: val_n=214, train_n=0, tv_lambda=0.001, tv_iterations=240, tv_lr=0.01, tv_clip_max=0.08, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=SIX-BOX tv_iterative iter-18: (a) PRIOR: hr 0.2085 peak @iter-4 (lam0.001,iters160,lr0.01,clip0.08,decay0.01,gd,fbp); iters12-17 all empty-patch confirms identical 0.20855. (b) RANKED #6, POSITIVE headroom. Lever audit: lam convex-optimized (0.003->0.137, 0.0005->0.158, 0.001->peak); lr monotone-worse above 0.01 (0.02->0.187); clip 0.1->0.205 worse than 0.08; iters 120/140/160 flat-noisy at top BUT upper side (>160) NEVER probed despite search-space allowing 500. More TV iterations = textbook route to lower data-residual -> higher SSIM/hr for a converging classical solver. (c) CHANGE: tv_iterations 160->240 (sole untested directional lever). (d) BUDGET: iter-17 elapsed 962s/~16min @160 iters; 240 iters ~14min linear-scaled, inside HARD 20-min. (e) BASE_ITER=4 (hr-best 0.2085). Probe with positive EV, not empty confirm — the iters axis upper half is unexplored.
